clash_types._role: D1: header-only value types. Everything may depend on it; it depends on nothing.

clash_yaml._role: D1: yaml helpers as their own leaf, so the packaged component never drags clash_config in (PRE-ARCH edge 5).

clash_preferences._role: The one accessor for the application's preference store. A leaf like clash_yaml: Qt6::Core only, so clash_backups, the UI and the composition root can each read a setting without depending on one another.

clash_config._role: Configuration composition and profile enhancement scripts.
_transitive_note: Qt6::Network is present only because Qt6::Qml re-exports it; the
configuration library itself makes no HTTP calls. It is listed so the
allowlist stays closed, not because it is wanted. Removing Qt6::Qml
would remove it. Widgets/Quick/Graphs remain forbidden here.

clash_profiles._note: PRE-ARCH edge 1 (clash_profiles -> clash_mihomo_impl) IS present and is baselined as E1-profiles-links-mihomo-impl, owner CFG-CORE, removed in P4. Qt6::Gui and Qt6::WebSockets appear here only as a consequence of that edge, reaching this module through clash_mihomo_impl -> clash_platform. All three disappear when the single vergeConfigPath() call at profile_store.cpp:722 is replaced by an injected seedDir.

clash_backups._note: Uses QThread/QSemaphore, not QtConcurrent: Qt6::Concurrent must not reappear.

clash-qt._note: Links the backend libraries directly; clash-qt-service-helper is an add_dependencies() edge, which the File API reports and which must therefore be declared like any other.

clash_test_support._note: Shared test infrastructure: scoped environment, loopback server, fake-core driver. Declared rather than ignored so that it becoming a consumer of production modules is a visible change, not a silent one.

exceptions.reason: DECISION D2. platform::PrivilegedServiceClient appears in CoreProcess's constructor signature (src/core/mihomo/process/core_process.h:31, forward-declared at :17), so the edge is PUBLIC. It is removed by injecting an abstract interface owned by clash_mihomo_impl; the privileged client is NOT absorbed into the component package.
DECISION D2, seen at file level. The single include site behind the baselined target edge. Frozen at one site: a second core file reaching into platform fails the check.
G2 blocker at link level: these targets link the component-private implementation directly. Frozen; MOD-CORE's published contract displaces them. A ninth linker fails the check.

PRE-ARCH 1b, the concrete G2 blocker: UI translation units include component-private mihomo headers, and src/ui/shell/main_window.h names core::CoreState in a slot signature. Frozen at 20 sites across 17 files; a 21st fails the check, and a site that disappears must be deleted from this list.

PRE-ARCH edge 1. ProfileStore::prepareRuntime calls core::vergeConfigPath() from controller_discovery.cpp to seed runtime data -- a SINGLE call site, src/core/profiles/profile_store.cpp:722. The edge was previously invisible because every consuming executable linked both libraries directly; partitioning the runtime suite exposed it. Declared rather than linked around, because the library genuinely cannot link standalone without it. Removing that one call site removes this exception AND both transitive-external entries below at once.
